notes: Admitted as a PINNED layer under the same pin-and-bump doctrine as OE-Core and BitBake. Only meta-oe and meta-python enter bblayers. Consumed only for named providers. Never track HEAD. Carries no distro identity - that objection applied to Poky (meta-yocto, DISTRO=poky), not to this.
required_by: Providers absent from OE-Core and needed by acquired components: python3-pybind11 and python3-pythran (scipy build deps), nodejs (npm.bbclass DEPENDS nodejs-native; blocks hls.js, anthropic-sdk-typescript, typescript-sdk, workers-sdk). Authoring pythran in-stack would drag gast, beniget and ply, making the ply vendoring collision live.
